evals.prompt: I dropped my notes and an old resume in evals/files/alex-rivera/. Use tech-resume-generator to make a general optimized tech resume for me.
evals.expected_output: Confirms career fixture files (or accepts listed evals/files), accepts/asks general mode, compiles professional_data.md from fixtures only, writes general_generated_resume.json + .pdf with skills→experience→education, no invented metrics, no street/DOB.
assertions: output/professional_data.md exists and mentions Alex Rivera
A resume JSON exists as output/general_generated_resume.json
Resume JSON validates against the generate_resume_pdf schema
Header name is Alex Rivera
Skills section has 2–3 categories
Experience is reverse-chronological with CloudNine before PixelForge
Education lists State University only (no fabricated schools)
No street address, photo, or DOB fields appear in the JSON
Bullets do not use helped/assisted/responsible for
No metric appears that is absent from the source fixtures (no invented percentages)
Sibling PDF exists for the resume JSON when Node/pdf-lib is available

evals.expected_output: Confirms career + JD fixtures, produces tailored_generated_resume.json + .pdf emphasizing React/TypeScript/accessibility from the JD only where true in Alex's data; still one page; no invented Acme employment.
assertions: A resume JSON exists as output/tailored_generated_resume.json
Resume JSON validates against the generate_resume_pdf schema
Skills or bullets mention React and TypeScript
Does not claim employment at Acme
Does not invent accessibility metrics not in fixtures
Header links remain Alex's real links from fixtures
Experience order still newest-first
